title: How do rockets work in empty space?
typed: How do rockets work in empty space?

cues.text: But this rocket carries its own fuel and oxygen,
so it has both ingredients it needs to burn.
The fuel and oxygen meet in this chamber.
They burn and make hot gas.
The nozzle speeds that gas out of the engine.
As the engine throws gas backward,
the gas pushes the rocket forward.
It doesn’t need to push against air.
That’s how a rocket can fly through empty space.

provenance.transcript:
There’s no air in space. But this rocket carries its own fuel and oxygen, so it has both ingredients it needs to burn.

The fuel and oxygen meet in this chamber. They burn and make hot gas. The nozzle speeds that gas out of the engine.

As the engine throws gas backward, the gas pushes the rocket forward. It doesn’t need to push against air. That’s how a rocket can fly through empty space.
